svg.title: act up aids fete poster
svg.text: IN AID OF ST. PETER'S CHURCH RESTORATION FUND
LIVE FOLK MUSIC FROM THE MUDDY BOOTS
ORGANISED BY BRINDLEWICK VILLAGE COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION.

g.data-flaw: Fragments of the pink artwork show through the reset headline, in the V and across VILLAGE and BRINDLEWICK.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: blanking misses the original's ink wherever the reset letters don't cover it, a builder bug worth fixing.
g.title: I know this conversion is flawed. Fragments of the pink artwork show through the reset headline, in the V and across VILLAGE and BRINDLEWICK. Fixable: blanking misses the original's ink wherever the reset letters don't cover it, a builder bug worth fixing.
